team_performance: What are our three biggest weaknesses this season?

SELECT gold_team_report_card.phase, gold_team_report_card.metric, ROUND(gold_team_report_card.value, 3) AS value, ROUND(gold_team_report_card.league_avg, 3) AS league_avg, gold_team_report_card.league_rank, gold_team_report_card.tier
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_report_card
WHERE gold_team_report_card.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_report_card)
  AND gold_team_report_card.team = 'NYG' AND gold_team_report_card.better <> 'neutral'
ORDER BY gold_team_report_card.league_rank DESC, gold_team_report_card.percentile ASC
LIMIT 3
How has our pass rush changed from last season to this season?

SELECT gold_team_report_card.season, gold_team_report_card.metric, ROUND(gold_team_report_card.value, 3) AS value, gold_team_report_card.league_rank, gold_team_report_card.tier
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_report_card
WHERE gold_team_report_card.team = 'NYG' AND gold_team_report_card.phase = 'Pass rush'
  AND gold_team_report_card.season >= (SELECT MAX(season) - 1 FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_report_card)
ORDER BY gold_team_report_card.metric, gold_team_report_card.season
How does our offense perform with play action versus without it this season?

SELECT CASE WHEN silver_ftn_charting.is_play_action THEN 'play action' ELSE 'no play action' END AS play_type, COUNT(*) AS dropbacks, ROUND(AVG(silver_plays.epa), 3) AS epa_per_dropback, ROUND(AVG(silver_plays.success), 3) AS success_rate
FROM workspace.nfl.silver_plays
JOIN workspace.nfl.silver_ftn_charting ON silver_ftn_charting.game_id = silver_plays.game_id AND silver_ftn_charting.play_id = silver_plays.play_id
WHERE silver_plays.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.silver_plays) AND silver_plays.season_type = 'REG'
  AND silver_plays.posteam = 'NYG' AND silver_plays.qb_dropback = 1 AND silver_plays.epa IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
Which teams are best on third down this season?

SELECT gold_team_report_card.team, ROUND(100 * gold_team_report_card.value, 1) AS third_down_pct, gold_team_report_card.league_rank
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_report_card
WHERE gold_team_report_card.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_report_card)
  AND gold_team_report_card.metric = '3rd down conversion rate'
ORDER BY gold_team_report_card.league_rank
LIMIT 10
How do we do in the red zone on offense and defense?

SELECT gold_team_phase_stats.side, gold_team_phase_stats.red_zone_trips, ROUND(100 * gold_team_phase_stats.red_zone_td_rate, 1) AS red_zone_td_pct
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_phase_stats
WHERE gold_team_phase_stats.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_phase_stats) AND gold_team_phase_stats.team = 'NYG'
Are we in playoff position right now?

SELECT gold_standings.team, gold_standings.wins, gold_standings.losses, gold_standings.ties, gold_standings.division, gold_standings.division_rank, gold_standings.division_games_back, gold_standings.conference_seed, gold_standings.in_playoff_position
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_standings
WHERE gold_standings.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.gold_standings) AND gold_standings.team = 'NYG'
roster_cap: Who are our most overpaid players right now?

SELECT gold_player_value.player_name, gold_player_value.position_group, gold_player_value.age, ROUND(gold_player_value.apy_m, 1) AS apy_m, gold_player_value.final_season, ROUND(100 * gold_player_value.snap_share) AS snap_pct, gold_player_value.production_metric_name, ROUND(gold_player_value.production_metric, 2) AS production, ROUND(100 * gold_player_value.value_score) AS value_score
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_value
WHERE gold_player_value.team = 'NYG' AND gold_player_value.value_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gold_player_value.value_score ASC
LIMIT 10
Which of our starters have contracts ending after this season?

SELECT gold_player_value.player_name, gold_player_value.position_group, gold_player_value.age, ROUND(gold_player_value.apy_m, 1) AS apy_m, ROUND(100 * gold_player_value.snap_share) AS snap_pct, ROUND(100 * gold_player_value.value_score) AS value_score
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_value
WHERE gold_player_value.team = 'NYG' AND gold_player_value.final_season <= gold_player_value.season AND gold_player_value.role = 'starter'
ORDER BY gold_player_value.snap_share DESC
How does our spending by position group compare to the league and the top teams?

SELECT gold_cap_allocation.position_group, ROUND(gold_cap_allocation.apy_m, 1) AS apy_m, ROUND(100 * gold_cap_allocation.share_of_team_apy, 1) AS our_share_pct, ROUND(100 * gold_cap_allocation.league_avg_share, 1) AS league_avg_pct, ROUND(100 * gold_cap_allocation.top8_avg_share, 1) AS top8_avg_pct
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_cap_allocation
WHERE gold_cap_allocation.team = 'NYG'
ORDER BY gold_cap_allocation.share_of_team_apy DESC
Find edge rushers on other teams who are outperforming their contracts.

SELECT gold_player_value.player_name, gold_player_value.team, gold_player_value.age, ROUND(gold_player_value.apy_m, 1) AS apy_m, gold_player_value.final_season, gold_player_value.sacks_plus_hits, ROUND(gold_player_value.production_metric, 2) AS sacks_hits_per_100_snaps, ROUND(100 * gold_player_value.value_score) AS value_score
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_value
WHERE gold_player_value.position_group = 'EDGE' AND gold_player_value.team <> 'NYG' AND gold_player_value.value_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gold_player_value.value_score DESC
LIMIT 10
Which teams spend the most on quarterbacks and how efficient are their quarterbacks?

SELECT gold_cap_allocation.team, ROUND(gold_cap_allocation.apy_m, 1) AS qb_apy_m, ROUND(100 * gold_cap_allocation.share_of_team_apy, 1) AS qb_share_pct, gold_team_season.net_epa_rank, gold_team_season.wins, gold_team_season.losses
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_cap_allocation
JOIN workspace.nfl.gold_team_season ON gold_team_season.team = gold_cap_allocation.team AND gold_team_season.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_season)
WHERE gold_cap_allocation.position_group = 'QB'
ORDER BY gold_cap_allocation.apy_m DESC
LIMIT 10
personnel: Which wide receivers create the most separation this season?

SELECT gold_player_advanced.player_name, gold_player_advanced.latest_team, gold_player_advanced.targets, gold_player_advanced.receiving_yards, ROUND(gold_player_advanced.avg_separation, 2) AS separation_yds, ROUND(gold_player_advanced.receiving_epa, 1) AS receiving_epa
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_advanced
WHERE gold_player_advanced.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_advanced) AND gold_player_advanced.position = 'WR' AND gold_player_advanced.avg_separation IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gold_player_advanced.avg_separation DESC
LIMIT 10
Which running backs have the best rush yards over expected per carry this season (minimum 50 carries)?

SELECT gold_player_advanced.player_name, gold_player_advanced.latest_team, gold_player_advanced.carries, gold_player_advanced.rushing_yards, ROUND(gold_player_advanced.rush_yards_over_expected_per_att, 2) AS ryoe_per_att, ROUND(100 * gold_player_advanced.stacked_box_rate, 1) AS stacked_box_pct
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_advanced
WHERE gold_player_advanced.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_advanced) AND gold_player_advanced.carries >= 50 AND gold_player_advanced.rush_yards_over_expected_per_att IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gold_player_advanced.rush_yards_over_expected_per_att DESC
LIMIT 10
Which pass rushers get to the quarterback most often per snap this season?

SELECT gold_player_advanced.player_name, gold_player_advanced.latest_team, gold_player_advanced.position, gold_player_advanced.defense_snaps, gold_player_advanced.sacks_plus_hits, ROUND(gold_player_advanced.sacks_hits_per_100_snaps, 1) AS sacks_hits_per_100_snaps
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_advanced
WHERE gold_player_advanced.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_advanced) AND gold_player_advanced.position_group IN ('DL', 'LB') AND gold_player_advanced.defense_snaps >= 150
ORDER BY gold_player_advanced.sacks_hits_per_100_snaps DESC
LIMIT 10
Who is on our injury report this week and how important are they?

SELECT gold_injury_report.player_name, gold_injury_report.position, gold_injury_report.report_status, gold_injury_report.injury, gold_injury_report.practice_status, gold_injury_report.role, ROUND(100 * gold_injury_report.snap_share) AS snap_pct, gold_injury_report.week
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_injury_report
WHERE gold_injury_report.team = 'NYG'
ORDER BY CASE gold_injury_report.report_status WHEN 'Out' THEN 1 WHEN 'Doubtful' THEN 2 WHEN 'Questionable' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, gold_injury_report.snap_share DESC
Which quarterbacks have played for us this season and in which weeks?

SELECT silver_player_week.player_name, MIN(silver_player_week.week) AS first_week, MAX(silver_player_week.week) AS last_week, COUNT(*) AS games, SUM(silver_player_week.attempts) AS attempts, ROUND(SUM(silver_player_week.passing_epa), 1) AS passing_epa
FROM workspace.nfl.silver_player_week
WHERE silver_player_week.season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM workspace.nfl.silver_player_week) AND silver_player_week.season_type = 'REG'
  AND silver_player_week.team = 'NYG' AND silver_player_week.position = 'QB' AND silver_player_week.attempts > 0
GROUP BY silver_player_week.player_name
ORDER BY first_week
draft: Where are we projected to pick in the next draft?

SELECT gold_draft_order_projection.draft_year, gold_draft_order_projection.projected_pick, gold_draft_order_projection.team, gold_draft_order_projection.wins, gold_draft_order_projection.losses, gold_draft_order_projection.ties, gold_draft_order_projection.in_playoff_position
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_draft_order_projection
WHERE gold_draft_order_projection.team = 'NYG'
How have our draft classes performed over the last ten mature classes compared with the league?

SELECT gold_draft_team_grades.draft_year, gold_draft_team_grades.picks, gold_draft_team_grades.hits, gold_draft_team_grades.pro_bowlers, ROUND(gold_draft_team_grades.surplus_av, 1) AS surplus_av, gold_draft_team_grades.class_rank
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_draft_team_grades
WHERE gold_draft_team_grades.team = 'NYG' AND gold_draft_team_grades.draft_year >= (SELECT MAX(draft_year) - 9 FROM workspace.nfl.gold_draft_team_grades)
ORDER BY gold_draft_team_grades.draft_year
Which teams have drafted best over the last ten mature classes?

SELECT gold_draft_team_grades.team, SUM(gold_draft_team_grades.picks) AS picks, SUM(gold_draft_team_grades.hits) AS hits, SUM(gold_draft_team_grades.pro_bowlers) AS pro_bowlers, ROUND(SUM(gold_draft_team_grades.surplus_av), 1) AS surplus_av
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_draft_team_grades
WHERE gold_draft_team_grades.draft_year >= (SELECT MAX(draft_year) - 9 FROM workspace.nfl.gold_draft_team_grades)
GROUP BY gold_draft_team_grades.team
ORDER BY surplus_av DESC
LIMIT 10
Which positions have the best hit rate in the first round?

SELECT gold_draft_position_value.position, gold_draft_position_value.picks, ROUND(100 * gold_draft_position_value.hit_rate, 1) AS hit_rate_pct, ROUND(100 * gold_draft_position_value.pro_bowl_rate, 1) AS pro_bowl_pct, ROUND(gold_draft_position_value.avg_av_for_team, 1) AS avg_av
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_draft_position_value
WHERE gold_draft_position_value.round = 1 AND gold_draft_position_value.picks >= 15
ORDER BY gold_draft_position_value.hit_rate DESC
What were our best and worst draft picks since 2010?

SELECT gold_draft_pick_value.draft_year, gold_draft_pick_value.round, gold_draft_pick_value.pick, gold_draft_pick_value.player_name, gold_draft_pick_value.position, gold_draft_pick_value.dr_av, ROUND(gold_draft_pick_value.expected_dr_av, 1) AS slot_expected_av, ROUND(gold_draft_pick_value.surplus_av, 1) AS surplus_av
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_draft_pick_value
WHERE gold_draft_pick_value.team = 'NYG' AND gold_draft_pick_value.draft_year >= 2010 AND gold_draft_pick_value.is_mature
ORDER BY gold_draft_pick_value.surplus_av DESC
What did first-round edge rushers who became Pro Bowlers run in the 40-yard dash?

SELECT gold_draft_pick_value.player_name, gold_draft_pick_value.draft_year, gold_draft_pick_value.pick, silver_combine.forty, silver_combine.weight_lb, gold_draft_pick_value.probowls
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_draft_pick_value
JOIN workspace.nfl.silver_combine ON silver_combine.pfr_player_id = gold_draft_pick_value.pfr_player_id
WHERE gold_draft_pick_value.round = 1 AND gold_draft_pick_value.position IN ('DE', 'OLB', 'EDGE') AND gold_draft_pick_value.probowls > 0 AND silver_combine.forty IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY silver_combine.forty
